nomenclature.BOUNDARY_INCIDENCE: vertex occurs on a face boundary walk; no movement authority
nomenclature.FACE: topological planar region; incidence may be many-to-many
nomenclature.FREE_FOR_FACE: degree 2 and both incident graph edges are exactly that face's two incident boundary edges
nomenclature.OWNER_FACE: the unique face granting movement authority
nomenclature.PULL_CELL: disjoint movement unit owned by one face
nomenclature.PULL_LAYER: face-adjacency depth assigned through Owner Face
nomenclature.SHARED_BOUNDARY_VERTEX: one graph vertex boundary-incident to multiple faces
